doc: P1.DATA.3.LITE — manual source_url repoints for listings whose API-stored source_url points to an ended Eventbrite event instance. Each entry must have been hand-verified to (a) be HTTP 200, (b) carry no HTML 'event ended'/'sales ended' badge, (c) have a title that shares the listing's distinctive tokens (venue or brand). Loose matches (e.g. same organizer but different show) are NOT included; those listings stay needs_human_review until a verified URL exists.
